description: Make player-visible Fair nouns physically referable without pretending phase-moving people are present.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE FAIR-ROAD-FCN (RARG)
    <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
           <TELL "A packed public road leaves the clearing toward a meadow. ">
replacements.new:
<OBJECT FAIR-ENTRANCE-NOTICE
    (IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
    (SYNONYM NOTICE SIGN STEWARD)
    (ADJECTIVE PAINTED FAIR MEETING)
    (DESC "painted steward notice")
    (FLAGS NDESCBIT)
    (ACTION FAIR-ENTRANCE-NOTICE-FCN)>

<ROUTINE FAIR-ENTRANCE-NOTICE-FCN ()
    <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE READ>
           <TELL "A painted notice, signed Berrin Vale, Fair Steward, marks this as a meeting point and says general admission is free." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<OBJECT FAIR-MIRROR-SCREW
    (IN CROOKED-GALLERY)
    (SYNONYM SCREW FASTENER)
    (ADJECTIVE BRASS EAST FRAME)
    (DESC "brass frame screw")
    (FLAGS NDESCBIT TRYTAKEBIT)
    (ACTION FAIR-MIRROR-SCREW-FCN)>

<ROUTINE FAIR-MIRROR-SCREW-FCN ()
    <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
           <TELL "The brass screw sits firmly in the east mirror frame. Its worn slot is a real construction mark, not an opening or a maze switch." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? TAKE TURN MUNG>
           <TELL "The screw is seated firmly in the frame. Casual handling will not free it." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<OBJECT FAIR-POND-BANK
    (IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
    (SYNONYM BANK SHORE)
    (ADJECTIVE SHADED POND)
    (DESC "shaded pond bank")
    (FLAGS NDESCBIT)
    (ACTION FAIR-POND-BANK-FCN)>

<ROUTINE FAIR-POND-BANK-FCN ()
    <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
           <TELL "Grass and packed earth slope gently to the working pond. The shade is deeper here, useful for waiting with a rod or getting out of the fair's busiest paths." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE FAIR-ROAD-FCN (RARG)
    <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
           <TELL "A packed public road leaves the clearing toward a meadow. ">
